nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances in UniswapExchange; read and written with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom/batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spend allowances; mutated with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Private privileged address that gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress and is whitelisted in ensure().
Whitelisted trading address set only by owner; checked inside ensure().
Per-address sale counter incremented on each transferFrom and compared against _saleNum in condition().
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist bypassing the sale-condition check in ensure().
Minimum transfer value enforced by condition(); configured by owner in init().
Maximum transfer value enforced by condition(); configured by owner in init().
Maximum allowed sales per address enforced by condition(); configured by owner in init().
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used to scale supply and sale limits.
Hard-coded Uniswap Router address whitelisted in the constructor allowance and referenced in ensure().
Payable constructor that sets metadata, mints the full supply to msg.sender and grants an unlimited allowance to the hard-coded UNI router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist gate: returns true for owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked allowance/balance subtraction and addition without SafeMath; core of the vulnerable token logic.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale restrictions.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the caller, granting full control over contract storage.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; declared returns(bool) but returns nothing.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies _value by array length and debits balances without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Pure function computing the deterministic Uniswap pair address for the token and WETH.
Private SafeERC20 helper performing a raw low-level call to an external token contract and decoding optional return data.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, approvals, account debits and the delegatecall gate.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode in the storage context of the contract (backdoor).
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend can overflow.
address(token).call(data) low-level call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn which can invoke a malicious token and re-enter.
